description:
List experiments — Retrieve a paginated list of experiments (dataset runs). Each experiment is a group of traces that share a `DatasetRunId`, typically produced when a prompt is evaluated against every row in a dataset.

Response includes per-experiment aggregates (item count, avg latency, total cost, avg score) plus filter options (distinct prompt names and dataset paths) so UI consumers can populate dropdowns without a second request.
name: list_experiments
